english: The four observations $a,\ a+d,\ a+2d,\ a+3d$, where $d>0$, have arithmetic mean $11$. In a frequency distribution, the values $a,\ a+d,\ a+2d,\ a+3d$ occur with frequencies $1,3,9,27$, respectively, and the arithmetic mean of this frequency distribution is $15.2$. Then the variance of this frequency distribution is ______.
hindi: चार प्रेक्षणों $a,\ a+d,\ a+2d,\ a+3d$, जहाँ $d>0$ है, का समान्तर माध्य $11$ है। एक बारंबारता बंटन में मान $a,\ a+d,\ a+2d,\ a+3d$ क्रमशः बारंबारताओं $1,3,9,27$ के साथ आते हैं, तथा इस बारंबारता बंटन का समान्तर माध्य $15.2$ है। तब इस बारंबारता बंटन का प्रसरण ______ है।
solution_full: The mean of the four AP terms is the mean of the first and last: $\dfrac{a+(a+3d)}{2}=a+\dfrac32d=11$.
In the frequency distribution, value $a+kd$ has frequency $3^k$ ($k=0,1,2,3$), $N=1+3+9+27=40$.
Mean $=a+d\cdot\dfrac{\sum k3^k}{40}$. The arithmetico-geometric sum $S=\sum_{k=0}^3k3^k$: $S-3S=3+9+27-3\cdot81=-204$, so $S=102$.
originality_note: New: AP values carry GP frequencies, so the weighted mean is an arithmetico-geometric sum; together with the plain AP mean it fixes a and d, and the variance follows by coding (way 5: AP mean and an AGP inside a frequency distribution). Closest known: 'sum of the AGP 1 + 2x + 3x^2 + ...'. Different because: the AGP appears as a weighted mean and the two means together pin down the progression.
stem_review: Read as a student: every observation, class, symbol and condition is introduced before use, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently in Python (exact fractions / sympy), is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Changed: No change.
key_step: Recognising the weighted mean as a + d (sum k 3^k)/40 and solving with the AP mean.
justification: Three stages (AGP sum, solving for a and d, variance) with exact decimals and no options. Above 2026-P2-Q12 (L2); Level 3.

concept_use.Mean and variance of the first n natural: The mean of the AP, a + 3d/2 = 11, and coding the AP values as a + kd for the variance.
concept_use.Sum of an Arithmetico Geometric Progress: Sum k 3^k (k = 0..3) = 102 for the weighted mean, by the S - rS method.
